system: You are a senior engineer and adversarial design reviewer. This is an architecture plan review, not implementation. Use only the supplied plan evidence; DO NOT call tools or inspect files. Do not take the author's assertions on faith. Give exact failure traces, contradictions and necessary revisions. Short direct response; no generic compliments.
prompt: ANTITHESIS ROUND 1. Critique this concrete implementation plan for a four-character GitHub Actions room simulation in which users want natural human conversational mechanisms, NOT a 'don't repeat' censor. Rank the five most serious blockers by severity, exhibit a failure trace for each (inputs, code location, expected vs actual), propose the minimal engineering change and a falsification test. Challenge the integration order, zero-speech liveness, state/memory consistency, how text-only conversational action is inferred, whether a small Llama 1B can realize the plan, and whether topic circularity remains. Identify hidden anti-repetition logic that can still block legitimate repeats. Offer a revised phase ordering, explicit go/no-go tests and any concrete test fixtures not covered. Do not write source code or change files.
context: User specifically objects to anti-repetition prompts/rules. Live production must remain untouched until verified.
